content.short: Maverick is a high-efficiency DEX featuring a Dynamic Distribution AMM that automates liquidity movement for users.
content.description: Maverick Protocol is an advanced decentralized finance infrastructure designed to provide superior capital efficiency for liquidity providers and traders. The platform's core innovation is its Dynamic Distribution Automated Market Maker (AMM), which allows liquidity to automatically follow asset prices as they move. This ensures that capital is always concentrated in the most active price ranges, significantly increasing fee capture for providers and reducing slippage for users. Operating across major networks including Ethereum, Base, and zkSync Era, Maverick serves as a primary venue for deep liquidity and professional-grade asset exchange on-chain.
content.meta: Maverick offers professional-grade AMM trading with dynamic liquidity distribution for capital efficiency. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
